one_line: Defender of Siwana and the Delhi Sultan who captured it during Alauddin Khalji’s expansion into Rajasthan, 1308 CE.

appearance.age_look: Both appear in their late 30s to early 40s, athletic and battle-hardened, with upright, commanding postures.
appearance.face: Sitaladeva has a sharp oval face, wheatish Marwari complexion, trimmed mustache with a short pointed beard, a thin vertical tilak scar on his forehead, and calm, resolute eyes; Alauddin has a broader face with a slightly darker North Indian complexion, thick arched brows, a fuller trimmed beard, and a penetrating, calculating gaze; both default to focused, serious expressions.
appearance.hair: Sitaladeva’s black hair is medium length, tied back in a low knot under a deep-red Marwari turban with a slightly forward-leaning crest and a thin gold border; Alauddin’s dark hair is mostly hidden beneath a dark emerald-green quilted war-cap topped with a steel conical helmet, a short dark cloth aventail covering the sides and back of his head.
appearance.costume: Sitaladeva wears an era-accurate Rajput warrior ensemble: a knee-length quilted cotton tunic (padded coat) in muted saffron with subtle diamond stitching, side slits at the hips, and a simple leather belt; over this a fitted mail shirt peeks at the sleeves and hem, with a small round iron breastplate strapped in front; his lower body is covered with off-white, slightly loose churidar-style trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; he has a deep-red cotton sash tied at the waist, one end falling to the left, and a narrow band of patterned maroon-and-gold textile edging the tunic; he wears modest gold stud earrings, a simple black thread necklace with a small metal pendant tucked under the tunic, and a plain iron armlet on his right arm; Alauddin wears a quilted, knee-length dark green jamadār-style coat with vertical stitching, front opening tied with cords, over a visible mail shirt, and a slightly flared skirt; his trousers are simple dark brown, straight and tucked into sturdy black leather boots; around his waist is a broad reddish-brown leather belt with a metal buckle and attached dagger sheath; over the coat he has a plain rectangular dark blue woolen shawl draped back over one shoulder for warmth; his armour consists of a polished steel conical helmet with a nasal bar, a simple mail coif over his shoulders, and a small round shield slung on his back; he wears one plain silver ring and no ostentatious jewellery, emphasizing practical military attire.
appearance.signature: Sitaladeva’s signature weapon is a slightly curved Rajput talwar with a steel blade, a brass hilt with a disc pommel and modest knuckle-guard, carried in a plain brown leather scabbard at his left hip; Alauddin’s signature prop is a rolled parchment campaign map held in his left hand, with a plain wooden map case slung at his side, symbolizing his role as planner of sieges.

ref_desc: Sitaladeva Songara has a wheatish oval face with a trimmed mustache-beard, black hair in a low knot under a deep-red Marwari turban, saffron quilted tunic over mail with off-white churidar and brown boots, wielding a brass-hilted talwar, beside Alauddin Khalji in emerald-green quilted coat, steel helmet, dark trousers, black boots and mail, holding a rolled parchment map; their colours are saffron, deep red, emerald green, dark blue and steel grey.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of two historical figures standing side by side: Sitaladeva Songara as a Rajput defender of Siwana and Alauddin Khalji as the Delhi Sultan besieger. Sitaladeva is a late-30s Marwar Rajput with a wheatish complexion, sharp oval face, trimmed mustache and short pointed beard, a faint vertical tilak scar on his forehead, and calm but determined eyes; his black hair is tied in a low knot beneath a deep-red Marwari turban with a slightly forward-leaning crest and a thin gold border. He wears a knee-length, muted saffron quilted cotton tunic with subtle diamond stitching and small maroon-and-gold edging, over a visible mail shirt and a small round iron breastplate, with off-white churidar-style trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather boots; a deep-red cotton sash is tied at his waist, and he has modest gold stud earrings, a simple black-thread necklace with a tiny pendant, and a plain iron armlet. His left hip carries his signature slightly curved talwar in a brown leather scabbard, the steel blade and brass hilt with disc pommel and knuckle-guard shown clearly in one pose. Beside him, Alauddin Khalji appears in his early 40s with a slightly darker North Indian complexion, broader face, thick arched brows, fuller trimmed beard, and a stern, calculating gaze; his dark hair is mostly hidden under a dark emerald-green quilted war-cap and a polished steel conical helmet with a nasal bar, with a short dark cloth aventail at the sides and back. He wears a dark emerald-green knee-length quilted coat with vertical stitching over a visible mail shirt, dark brown straight trousers tucked into black leather boots, a broad reddish-brown leather belt with a metal buckle and dagger sheath, and a plain dark blue woolen shawl draped behind one shoulder, plus a small round shield on his back and one simple silver ring. In his hand he holds a rolled parchment campaign map with a plain wooden map case at his side as his signature prop. Use a coherent palette of saffron and deep red for Sitaladeva, emerald green and dark blue for Alauddin, with steel grey armour and realistic leather browns, and show multiple angles (front, three-quarter, back) to clearly display their consistent face shapes, hairstyles, garments and signature talwar and map without any text or labels.
